question: To whom and to anyone should this teaching never be given?
premises: The verse forbids giving to anyone.
The prohibition applies at all times.
inference: The teaching is to be withheld from all recipients always.
uncertainties: The exact referent of dātavya is unspecified.
The two dative forms may be rhetorical rather than distinct recipients.
plain_english: To whom? To anyone? It is never to be given, never to be given at any time.
